title.rendered: Naira reaches two-year high after rate cut

excerpt.rendered: The naira strengthened against the dollar to its highest level in two years, shaking off fears that followed the central bank’s recent interest rate cut. […]

title.rendered: Macron to make state visit to Nigeria before end of October

excerpt.rendered: French President Emmanuel Macron will make a state visit to Nigeria before the end of October, officials said.
